lead.title: Archeon Medical raises $9M Series A led by Newfund (HEKA fund) to validate its EOlife device in cardiac arrest
lead.deck: Eiffel Investment Group, OSER BFC (UI Investissement), Majycc Innovation Santé and Karot Capital complete the round. EOlife, already CE-marked and FDA-cleared, measures in real time the air volume delivered to a cardiac arrest patient; the funds back studies in more than 1,500 patients (Amsterdam UMC, Rush University, Tualatin Valley Fire & Rescue).

milestone.title: Brainomix: its e-Lung tool tracks progression and treatment response in the Phase III INBUILD trial
milestone.summary: In 474 patients with progressive pulmonary fibrosis, e-Lung's quantitative CT biomarkers (total disease extent, reticulovascular score) detected the effect of nintedanib at weeks 24 and 52; higher baseline extent predicted faster decline in forced vital capacity.
milestone.why: An imaging biomarker validated on a large pharma's trial (Boehringer Ingelheim) points to use as an objective trial endpoint — a pharma revenue stream for this Oxford spin-off (£18.8M Series C).

brefsEurope.title: Reset Health and Pharmacy2U launch Averly Health, an integrated cardiometabolic care service
brefsEurope.summary: Clinical assessment, prescribing, pharmacy and follow-up for patients on GLP-1 drugs in a single pathway, built on infrastructure serving over 2 million patients a month. No investor or amount disclosed.

brefsIntl.title: Intuitive wins CE mark for da Vinci 5 in adult cardiac surgery in Europe
brefsIntl.summary: Includes coronary bypass without opening the sternum; Intuitive plans dedicated cardiac instruments and a limited number of partner European centers. A market comparable for European cardiac robotics.

brefsIntl.title: Happy Health gets FDA clearance for blood pressure measurement on its Happy Ring
brefsIntl.summary: The ring was first FDA-cleared in October 2024 for sleep apnea monitoring; the regulatory pathway and accuracy data are not specified.

brefsIntl.title: Siemens Healthineers partners with Truvian on its blood test platform
brefsIntl.summary: The alliance covers the TruVersus benchtop point-of-care analyzer; the companies will explore developing and commercializing future diagnostics. Financial terms undisclosed.

word.full: Quantitative CT (qCT, AI-based quantitative chest CT)
word.definition: AI software turns a CT scan into reproducible numbers (lesion volume, density, vessels) instead of a purely visual read by the radiologist.

how.t: A standard chest CT is sent to the software, with no extra exam.
The algorithm segments lungs, airways and vessels, then computes scores (e.g. total disease extent).
Scores are compared over time to track progression and treatment response.

word.why: For a VC, it bridges MedTech and pharma: an imaging biomarker validated in a Phase III trial can become a trial endpoint sold to drugmakers, on top of hospital revenue.
